description: The agent must: (1) Create ~/friends/ with four circle subdirectories: inner-circle/, close/, wider/, reconnecting/. (2) Create carlos-martinez.md in inner-circle/ with #inner-circle tag, all key facts (Barcelona, Studio Nomo, Lucia, Sofia, birthday), interaction log with Sep 2 2024 BEFORE Aug 15 2024 (recent-at-top rule), emotional state (stress about pitch) noted for Sep 2, and a follow-up flag about the hotel. (3) Create ana-sousa.md in close/ with #close tag, divorce as a life event, Porto, Loopify, therapy noted, and Sep 10 before Aug 3 in interaction log. (4) Create pedro-alves.md in wider/ with #wider tag and Berlin move as life event. (5) Create marta-ferreira.md in reconnecting/ with #reconnecting tag. (6) Create joao-ramos.md in wider/ noting Sara's baby as a life event. (7) Populate check-ins.md flagging Ana (divorce/support needed) and João (7 months since last contact, past quarterly threshold). (8) Populate index.md with all friends. (9) Use kebab-case filenames throughout. The key proprietary traps: circle-based folder placement, interaction log ordering (recent at top), frequency-vs-elapsed-time logic for check-ins.md, and the #tag convention per circle.
